divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: after the capped glob, a full folder enumeration, a per-prefix matter count (three prefixes at ten, three at nine, next tier eight), and engagement-letter reads or extraction scripts to name the client behind each leading prefix and resolve the two matters without an engagement file; the answer reports all six with the tie at the cutoff. Reviews kept flagging that prefix counts stood in for client counts; the runs answered with more client-name checks (T1 over four scan attempts and two agent-declared steps the reviewer had suggested, T2 with two agent-declared recount stages after writing) without changing the count. Label notes: three start notes were ignored; of eight end-of-stage label notes followed by more such work, four were followed and four ignored.
